title: Matched terminal-frontier ablation
caption: N=4, T=20 ms, 128 paired states, v=20m/s and 0.75-ms reports. Bars are global simultaneous 95% paired-t intervals. Forecasts remain certificate-based; each reporting method and its no-report comparator use the same terminal allocator. Host elapsed time is excluded.

title: Independent stratified report-value audit
caption: 3,072 candidate values in 192 fresh states, three independent 64-state traffic blocks and a bidirectional 16-coordinate catalogue. Candidate errors within one state are dependent. The root reference uses 1e-8 endpoint tolerance.
